create_fish_swim_env: create a fish swimming environment using the Swim class with default configuration
run_fish_environment_step: run a fish environment step with an action array and return the updated state
reset_fish_environment: reset the fish environment with a JAX random number generator array
get_fish_environment_obs: get the observation array from the fish environment including upright, joint angles, and mouth-to-target position
calculate_fish_reward: calculate the fish reward combining in-target tolerance and upright metrics
